Job Title: Neurophysiological Diagnostic Specialist — Kantonsspital Aarau (KSA), Aarau

Job Description:

The Kantonsspital Aarau (KSA) is seeking a highly qualified neurophysiological diagnostic specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in neurophysiology and a proven track record in diagnostic imaging and electrophysiological testing. The role involves conducting comprehensive neurophysiological examinations, interpreting results, and providing expert advice to patients and healthcare professionals.

Responsibilities:

- Conducting neurophysiological examinations, including electroencephalography (EEG), electromyography (EMG), and nerve conduction studies (NCS).
- Interpreting and reporting on diagnostic results, ensuring accurate and timely communication with referring physicians and patients.
- Collaborating with the multidisciplinary team to develop and implement diagnostic strategies for complex neurological cases.
- Staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in neurophysiology and diagnostic techniques.
- Providing education and training to medical students and junior staff on neurophysiological diagnostic procedures.
- Maintaining and updating the diagnostic equipment and ensuring the quality of the diagnostic services.

Qualifications:

- A medical degree and specialized training in neurophysiology.
- Extensive experience in neurophysiological diagnostic procedures.
- Proficiency in using diagnostic equipment and software.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
- Fluency in German and English.

Application:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and qualifications. Applications should be sent to the Human Resources Department of Kantonsspital Aarau.
